orientation.top_of_map: north (the lane in front of the house)
orientation.note_en: The lane runs along the top edge; the brass-plated front door faces north onto it; the back yard with the cucumber-frame, ladder corner and apple tree lies below the house (south); the chimney stack is on the east (right) gable. Camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks.

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from the lane toward the neat brick cottage, the green front door with its bright brass plate centred between two sash windows, slate roof and chimney above
eye-level medium shot from the swept front step looking out along the lane, the wood's edge beyond
eye-level wide shot from under the old apple tree across the yard to the back of the house, the upstairs window above the glinting cucumber-frame
low-angle close shot from beside the cucumber-frame looking straight up the back wall at the upstairs window framed by roses
high oblique medium shot from the top of the tied ladders at the yard corner across loose slates to the broad chimney stack and its clay pots
eye-level wide shot from the paling fence at the wood's edge across the kitchen-garden yard, the old apple tree in front and the cottage behind
high oblique detail shot from the upstairs window sill down onto the sloping glass lights of the cucumber-frame
eye-level wide shot from the sunlit west gable along the back of the house to the far yard corner where the ladders go up
low-angle close shot from the foot of the ladders along the dusty yard ground to the cucumber-frame and its broken glass

checklist.note_en: chimney stack drawn attached just outside the east gable end; accepted
